cases.name: Gina L. Mann
cases.about: Her obituary said Gina was a former Sandusky County Youth Correction Officer, and a full-time mom, devotedly raising her four children. She was a loving daughter, granddaughter, sister, aunt, cousin, mother and friend. Gina was a free-spirited person who could always be found helping those in need. Gina loved animals, especially dolphins, crafting with her family, camping, fishing, working in her garden, and bowling.
